name: Fieldstone Bakery
description: Morning buns, rye sourdough and the best coffee between Albany and the city. Go early on Saturday.
our_note: We get the cardamom bun every time.

name: Warren Street Noodle Bar
description: Hand-pulled noodles and dumplings in a tiny room with twelve stools. Worth the wait.
our_note: Ezra's pick for a post-flight dinner.

name: Kaaterskill Falls
description: A two-tier waterfall in the Catskills, about forty minutes from Willowbank. The short trail to the viewing platform is easy; the stairs to the base are not.
our_note: Wear real shoes, not wedding shoes.

name: Hollow Barrel Cider House
description: A family cider house with a tasting room in an old dairy barn. They make the cider we're pouring at the wedding.
our_note: Try the dry one with ginger.

name: Olana State Historic Site
description: The hilltop home and landscape of the painter Frederic Church, with a famous view down the Hudson River. The grounds are open every day.
our_note: Best at sunset, with a picnic.

name: Poets' Walk Park
description: An easy two-mile loop through meadows to a gazebo above the river. Good for a Sunday walk before you drive home.

name: Second Chapter Books
description: A secondhand bookshop with a back room full of first editions and a shop cat called Pip.
our_note: Where we'd go on a rainy afternoon.

name: The Low Bar
description: A candlelit cocktail bar below a hardware store. Small, so go before nine.
our_note: Our planning HQ for this whole wedding.

name: Front Street Gallery
description: A light-filled gallery showing painters and photographers from the Hudson Valley, a few doors from the Catskill Mill Inn.
our_note: Free, and open late on Fridays.

name: Kitchen at Cold Brook
description: Farm-to-table dinners in a converted schoolhouse. Book ahead for a weekend table.
our_note: Where we had our engagement dinner.

name: Warren Street antiques
description: Half a mile of antique shops, design stores and galleries. Easy to lose an afternoon here.
our_note: Maren will want to come with you.

name: Tivoli Bays
description: Tidal marshes on the Hudson with quiet trails and a canoe launch. Look for herons in the early morning.
